description: Google Analytics setup (owner «настраивай»; R3 key events after owner «Да» to leads as goals, 2026-10-25; 20261026: event-scoped custom dimension «placement» of autoria_click after owner «Да»). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run analytics_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which reads the server-held service account key, finds the owner property «UA ART», creates its web data stream for www.uaart.com.ua if missing, sets event retention to 14 months, marks the site leads (generate_lead, contact) as key events and registers missing custom dimensions (placement). The key never leaves the server; the report is checked for key material. No source, CRM, HTML, media or bot change.
title: Google Analytics setup
